_about: Voice direction for Chatterbox (scripts/make_voice_cb.py). One entry per script LINE (split=line). exag = emotion intensity, cfg = pacing (lower = slower), pause = silence after (s), say = spoken text, note = acting intention. Timbre: voice B (Kokoro bm_george reference, out/doomsday/vs/ref_bm_george.wav), picked by the user for iteration 7 and kept.

lines.say: This Halloween, twenty-five say-ances tried to summon the same dead man.
lines.note: hook: spooky campfire storyteller, weight on 'same dead man'
deadpan punchline, slow, a beat after
showman intro on the name; list builds; 'a dead whale' tossed off, amused

lines.say: But his favourite hobby? Crashing say-ances. In disguise. With a cop.

lines.note: incredulous, a smile on 'real magic powers'

lines.say: Then, in nineteen twenty-six, a college student punched him in the stomach.
lines.note: sudden turn, the punch lands on 'punched'
secretive, almost a whisper on 'Rosabelle, believe'

lines.say: Bess held a say-ance every Halloween, for ten years. Nothing.

lines.note: bittersweet, dry humour on the quote
to the viewer, spooky whisper, then a wink on 'his greatest escape'
